summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Barclays PLC disclosing an ordinary share transaction under its share incentive plan for a person discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMR), the Group Chief Risk Officer. On May 7, 2026, the plan trustee acquired 554 ordinary shares at £4.316 per share on behalf of the PDMR. No tender, merger, restructuring, or other special situation is involved. The filing is a standard notification of a PDMR dealing, required under UK market rules and furnished to the SEC for informational purposes. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are relevant.
